stubs.service: Outgoing relay SMTP server (the smarthost MailDev's 'Relay' action delivers to, e.g. SES/Mailgun)
stubs.how: MailDev is started with --outgoing-host 127.0.0.1 --outgoing-port 4426; .ui-capture/relay-stub.mjs (started by start.sh) is a local smtp-server that accepts every message, replies '250 2.0.0 Ok: queued as RLY…' and discards it. Relaying from the UI works and records relayedAt/relayedTo.

stubs.service: The application under test that sends mail to MailDev (a fictional clinic scheduling/billing SaaS, 'Fernhill')
stubs.how: .ui-capture/seed.mjs delivers its mail over SMTP (MailDev default port 1025) with nodemailer; all links in the emails point at http://localhost:3000 or example domains and are never fetched.

notes:
MailDev 3.0 (pnpm + turbo monorepo; node 22.23.5 + pnpm 10.34.4 pinned in mise.toml). Built with `pnpm install && pnpm build`; start.sh runs the real built CLI (packages/cli/dist/bin/maildev.js) with the React UI served by the same Fastify server on $PORT (4405), SMTP on 1025 (MailDev default), the relay stub on 4426, a fresh --mail-directory at .ui-capture/maildir, relay configured to the local stub, and MCP enabled. Only build-related change: package.json pnpm override iconv-lite@<0.7 -> 0.7.2 (the 0.6.3 tarball, pulled only by @types/mailparser, ships an .idea/ dir the sandbox can't write).

Data: on every start, seed.mjs (deterministic PRNG, dates relative to now) delivers ~260 emails over SMTP spanning the last ~4 months, as a developer's long-running MailDev would hold: verification codes, password resets, magic links, team invites, payment receipts with PDF invoices, failed-payment notices (high priority), appointment reminders with .ics files, weekly digests with inline chart images, CSV/JSON export attachments, support replies (plain text, threaded In-Reply-To), patient-note mentions, product newsletters, staging cron/Sidekiq failure alerts with stack traces (some off-hours/weekends, CC'd), team plain-text notes (deploy notes, a forwarded Spanish copy request, one with no subject), a maintenance notice to 5 recipients with CC + BCC, bursts of the same template re-sent while iterating, and a broken template with unrendered {{ placeholders }}. ~31 emails are unread (mostly the last few days, plus a few old ones never opened), the rest read; 4 were relayed (3 to their original recipients, 1 to a custom QA inbox — MailDev rewrites To: on custom relays), showing relayed status. Seeding takes ~1.5s after the server is healthy and appears live via WebSocket. Dates are rendered in date order, so invoice numbers, reminder dates and newsletter months line up with each email's send date. Read state is set through the app's own PATCH /api/email/read-all (delivered-then-marked) because GET /api/email/:id doesn't decrement MailDev's in-memory unread counter (upstream quirk).

Main areas: left sidebar email list (search box, total/unread count, unread items bold with filled avatar, attachment icon), email viewer on the right (header with from/to/cc/bcc, delete, download, relay menu; tabs HTML / Plain Text / Source / Headers, responsive-width preview 320px–1440px, attachments list), top header with theme/notification settings, and a command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K).
